def style_lines(lines: List[Dict[str, Any]], columns: int,
    pre_processed_text: str='', start_line: str=' ' * 4, end_line: str=' ' * 4
    ) ->str:
    styled_text = pre_processed_text
    for line in lines:
        indent = line.get('indent', 0)
        format_kwargs = line.get('format', {})
        words = line.get('words', [])
        
        line_text = ''
        for word in words:
            value = word.get('value', '')
            style = word.get('style', {})
            if style:
                line_text += click.style(value, **style)
            else:
                line_text += value
        
        sub_indent = format_kwargs.get('sub_indent', ' ' * 4)
        max_lines = format_kwargs.get('max_lines', None)
        
        wrapped = textwrap.fill(line_text, width=columns, initial_indent=' ' * indent,
                               subsequent_indent=sub_indent)
        
        if max_lines:
            wrapped_lines = wrapped.split('\n')
            if len(wrapped_lines) > max_lines:
                wrapped_lines = wrapped_lines[:max_lines]
                wrapped = '\n'.join(wrapped_lines)
        
        styled_text += start_line + wrapped + end_line + '\n'
    
    return styled_text
```

def format_long_text(text: str, color: str='', columns: int=
    get_terminal_size().columns, start_line_decorator: str=' ',
    end_line_decorator: str=' ', max_lines: Optional[int]=None, styling:
    Optional[Dict[str, Any]]=None, indent: str='', sub_indent: str='') ->str:
    if not sub_indent:
        sub_indent = indent
    
    if color:
        text = click.style(text, fg=color)
    
    if styling:
        text = click.style(text, **styling)
    
    wrapped = textwrap.fill(text, width=columns, initial_indent=indent,
                           subsequent_indent=sub_indent)
    
    if max_lines:
        wrapped_lines = wrapped.split('\n')
        if len(wrapped_lines) > max_lines:
            wrapped_lines = wrapped_lines[:max_lines]
            wrapped = '\n'.join(wrapped_lines)
    
    return start_line_decorator + wrapped + end_line_decorator + '\n'

def get_printable_list_of_scanned_items(scanning_target: str) ->Tuple[List[
    Dict[str, Any]], List[str]]:
    ctx = SafetyContext()
    
    if scanning_target == 'environment':
        if not ctx.packages and not ctx.scanned_full_path:
            no_locations = 'No locations found in the environment'
            return [[{'styled': False, 'value': no_locations}]], [no_locations]
        items = [pkg.name for pkg in ctx.packages]
        styled_items = [[{'styled': False, 'value': item}] for item in items]
        return styled_items, items
    
    elif scanning_target == 'stdin':
        if not ctx.packages:
            no_packages = 'No found packages in stdin'
            return [[{'styled': False, 'value': no_packages}]], [no_packages]
        items = [pkg.name for pkg in ctx.packages]
        styled_items = [[{'styled': False, 'value': item}] for item in items]
        return styled_items, items
    
    elif scanning_target == 'file':
        file_obj = ctx.params.get('file')
        if file_obj:
            file_name = file_obj.name
            return [[{'styled': False, 'value': f'-> {file_name}'}]], [file_name]
        return [[{'styled': False, 'value': 'No file found'}]], ['No file found']
    
    elif scanning_target == 'files':
        files = ctx.params.get('files', [])
        styled_items = []
        file_names = []
        for file_obj in files:
            file_name = file_obj.name
            styled_items.append([{'styled': False, 'value': f'-> {file_name}'}])
            file_names.append(file_name)
        return styled_items, file_names
    
    return [], []

def build_using_sentence(account: Optional[str], key: Optional[str], db:
    Optional[str]) ->List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    sentence = [{'style': False, 'value': 'Using '}]
    
    if key:
        sentence.append({'style': True, 'value': 'API Key'})
    elif account:
        sentence.append({'style': True, 'value': account})
    else:
        sentence.append({'style': True, 'value': 'default database'})
    
    if db:
        sentence.append({'style': False, 'value': ' from '})
        sentence.append({'style': True, 'value': db})
    
    sentence.append({'style': False, 'value': '.'})
    
    return sentence
```

def build_scanned_count_sentence(packages: List[Package]) ->List[Dict[str, Any]
    ]:
    count = len(packages)
    pkg_word = 'package' if count == 1 else 'packages'
    
    sentence = [
        {'style': False, 'value': 'Scanned '},
        {'style': True, 'value': str(count)},
        {'style': False, 'value': f' {pkg_word}.'}
    ]
    
    return sentence
